title: the rank-one criterion for a finitely presented relatively flat supported ideal on an etale scheme
statement: Let f:X→S be a quasi-compact separated etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let D be an effective Cartier ideal on S [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] and U=S minus |D|. Let K be a quasi-coherent ideal on X [pqf-def-coherent] whose associated module is finitely presented and whose stalk at each x is flat over O_{S,f(x)}. Assume that K restricts to the unit ideal on f^{-1}U [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. Then K is an invertible ideal, in the precise sense of affine-locally generated by a nonzerodivisor [def-nagata-invertible-ideal]. No blowup or existence of a modification occurs in this assertion.

proof.text: For any x over s, the etale fibre local ring at x is a field. Its module stalk is flat, since every module over a field is a vector space and free. Apply the finite-presentation flat-fibre free-neighbourhood criterion using relative flatness: K has finite free neighbourhoods everywhere.

Shrink a finite free neighbourhood to an affine open inside the inverse image of a Cartier chart. Because f is flat, the Cartier equation pulls back to a regular element d of its chart ring A. The Cartier-support injection makes A→A_d injective; for a nonempty affine chart A and A_d are nonzero.

The ideal is the unit ideal on D(d). Thus if the local free rank is r, localization yields A_d^r≅A_d. A residue field of the nonzero ring A_d forces r=1. The image a of a basis vector generates K on the chart and has injective multiplication, because A≅K embeds in A. Thus a is a nonzerodivisor and K is invertible. Empty schemes require no pointwise verification.

theorem isInvertible_of_etale_flat_finitePresentation
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Etale f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (D : S.IdealSheafData) (hD : D.IsInvertible)
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) [K.toModules.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hflat : ∀ x : X, Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk (f x))
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap x).hom).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj K.toModules)))
    (hunit : K.comap (f ⁻¹ᵁ D.support.compl).ι = ⊤) : K.IsInvertible
